candidate_2_adaptive_moment.map: Partition sources by an exact knot signature: periodic TSC nearest-node tuple, ordered epsilon breakpoints in [-8,8], and the fixed interval topology. Within a signature, retain interval polynomial coefficient sums through degree six for each population and frozen derivative direction. Sources with no shared signature remain singleton/overflow and are not approximated.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.state_contract: For signature h, population p, derivative direction j and interval r, retain C[p,h,j,r,k]=sum_i d_j m_i(theta) a[i,r,k] for k=0..6, where a[i,r,k] are the exact local-epsilon TSC product coefficients. j=0 is value/mass; j=1..22 are the frozen 23 JVP/VJP directions. No fiducial pre-summing is allowed.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.evaluation_equation: Rhat[p,c,j]=Z_T^-1 * sum_h sum_r sum_{k=0}^6 C[p,h,j,r,k] * mu_k(h,r), with mu_k(h,r)=integral_{break_r}^{break_{r+1}} epsilon^k phi(epsilon) d epsilon.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.error_control: Residual is exactly zero for a common exact knot signature because the Q1 integrand is degree six in epsilon on each fixed interval. There is no generic Taylor certificate across a knot; any non-signature bin is fail-closed/singleton rather than clipped or assigned a spurious seventh-order bound.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.cold_particle_rule: Use the exact Q1 zero-scale TSC branch when sigma=0. For 0<sigma<64*eps_float64*cell_spacing, use sourcewise exact evaluation; no regularization or derivative extrapolation is permitted.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.risk: Exact knot signatures can give G approximately M, so compression and full-field resource feasibility are unproven. This branch may reproduce Q1 exactly while providing no scalable speedup.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.promotion_condition: Only after a separately approved implementation demonstrates non-degenerate LOS/sigma development coverage, exact Q1 gates and a measured resource-safe compression ratio may this branch be considered for promotion.

candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.map: Deposit the full PM source mass/derivative basis to an intermediate N192 mesh with an explicitly frozen conservative kernel, retain joint LOS/sigma sufficient moments/tensor fields, then apply an analytic anisotropic cell-integrated LOS convolution. If joint statistics cannot be retained under the resource contract, candidate-3 is falsification-only and cannot be promoted.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.state_contract: The intermediate field must retain six population mass fields plus joint LOS/sigma moments sufficient for the anisotropic kernel and the exact JVP/VJP or frozen 23 directional derivative basis; no secure-object or scalar-density replacement is allowed.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.noncommutation_warning: Deposit and anisotropic LOS convolution are not assumed to commute. The candidate must be compared directly to the Q1 sourcewise oracle on the same source realization and topology.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.risk: Intermediate deposition can erase subcell position, LOS and sigma information. A failure is a scientific NO-GO, not a tolerance to relax.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.promotion_condition: Only exact or quantitatively bounded Q1 agreement with the frozen information-loss gates can authorize a differentiable implementation.
